recovery.callbackClose: Close this popup and try again from the original Workspace
recovery.identityChanged: Account changed. Previous drafts were cleared and hidden. The existing call and receiving point are not transferred to the new account.
recovery.popupFailed: Sign-in popup was blocked, cancelled or failed. Your draft remains here; try again.
recovery.discard: A draft or save command is unfinished. Leave this page and discard the draft?
recovery.authRequired: Session unavailable. Your draft and current call remain here; new calls stay closed.

availabilityFailed: Server could not confirm call availability. New calls remain closed.
snapshotLoadFailed: Could not load status from the API; remote control is not available yet
offerConfirmFailed: Could not confirm the incoming offer with the API
autoplayBlocked: The browser blocked incoming call audio. Allow audio playback and try again.
micEnded: The microphone stopped. New calls are closed; check your audio device again.
micBlocked: Workspace cannot use the microphone. Allow access or connect an audio device and try again.
registerFailed: dphone registration failed, so new calls stay closed
wrapupFailed: Could not submit the disposition. Try again with the same data.

heading.title: Agent Workspace
heading.lede: Get your browser and audio device ready before taking calls

governance.required: Contact must be checked before outbound

wrapup.title: After-call wrap-up
wrapup.copy: Submit a disposition before returning to available
wrapup.reconciling: Checking the command and recorded result before accepting new work
wrapup.recoveringInteraction: The unfinished command belongs to interaction {{interactionId}}, not new work
wrapup.alreadyCompleted: Another command completed this task. The server result is shown without overwriting it.
wrapup.unknown: The save outcome is unknown. Retry the same command; editing stays locked to prevent duplicate results.
wrapup.upgradeRequired: This task requires the new note-saving service. Contact your administrator to upgrade.

media.title: Prepare audio device
media.copy: The system asks for the microphone and checks that the browser can open a media stream before allowing voice offers

availability.title: Call availability
availability.readyHint: The router can send voice offers to this working tab
availability.notReadyHint: Pass the audio device check before opening for calls

authority.title: Trusted state
authority.note: The browser shows a projection and sends intents only; it never creates durable interaction state

passive.title: Workspace is working in another tab
passive.body: This tab is view-only and will not open routing or a media session until you move work here

lease.errorTitle: Could not check where you work
lease.errorBody: This place is not taking new work yet; retrying automatically
lease.heldTitle: You are taking work somewhere else
lease.heldBody: An account can take work in one place at a time. This place is view-only and does not start routing or dphone until you move work here
lease.freeBody: No place is taking work for this account right now. You can start here
lease.busy: A call or wrap-up is in progress there; you can move once it ends

loss.takeover: Work moved to another place; this place stopped taking new work
loss.expired: The connection was lost for too long; this place stopped taking new work
loss.auth_revoked: Your sign-in expired; this place stopped taking new work
loss.released: The work place was released; this place stopped taking new work

rejected.busy: Could not move: work is in progress at the current place. The call and connection there were not interrupted
rejected.changed: The work place changed in the meantime. Check the details and confirm again
rejected.failed: Could not move. Please try again

lease.confirmBody: The current place stops taking work immediately, and offers waiting to be accepted return to the queue
lease.inHand: This place stopped taking new work — your current call or work can continue until it ends

layout.workEmptyHint: Work assigned to you appears here once you are available
layout.noCurrentHint: Check your audio device and become available in the Readiness column
layout.recentEmpty: No wrap-up saved in this session yet

customer.title: Customer for this work
customer.unavailable: Customer information or access is unavailable. Reauthenticate and retry.
customer.quarantined: Customer information is hidden and the draft stays in memory. Voice continues under its existing policy.
customer.unknown: Save outcome is unknown. Check status before starting another command.
customer.notApplied: The command had no committed effect. Review the draft before retrying.
customer.conflict: The customer or work changed. Review the latest information before saving.
customer.saved: Saved and read back the current customer
customer.savedChanged: The command succeeded, but the current information has changed again.
customer.unchanged: No changes; read back the current customer
customer.empty: No selectable customers found. Work may continue without a customer link.
customer.unverified: Matches do not verify identity. Always select explicitly.
customer.name: Customer name
customer.unlinked: This work has no customer link
customer.query: Full international phone number or email address
customer.confirmDetach: Confirm detaching the customer from this work
